title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: front-of-room display defaults to attendee view in webinars and structured meetings
summary: The default display behaviour, Teams Rooms Pro requirement and rollout details are supported by Microsoft's notice and documentation. The cost rating needs correction: it describes indirect costs only while its rationale also includes purchasing Pro licences for rooms that lack them.

claims.claim: An Android Teams Room invited as a presenter in a webinar or structured meeting defaults its front-of-room display to attendee view.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate feature price, meter or credit rate is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android front-of-room view webinar feature price meter credit rate Pro license; opened rooms-licensing, rooms-release-note and the MTR event help page; read MC1316231. These document Pro entitlement, not a separate feature price, meter or credit rate.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and controls[0].api; summary; Governance controls
claims.claim: No tenant admin UI or automation control for the default front-of-room webinar and structured-meeting view is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android front-of-room default attendee view admin policy configuration PowerShell API. Read rooms-release-note, rooms-licensing, mtr-home-refresh search excerpts and MTR event help; found presenter console buttons, not a tenant default-view setting or API.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises ensuring Teams Rooms on Android devices are updated.
claims.quote: Verify device readiness: Ensure Teams Rooms on Android devices are updated.

claims.claim: Microsoft has already revised the rollout timeline.
claims.quote: Updated September 22, 2026: We have updated the timeline. Thank you for your patience.

claims.claim: The event organiser can add the room as a presenter when adding it to the event.
claims.quote:
When you add an MTR to an event, you can either add it as a presenter or an attendee.
In Setup > Details section, add the MTR in the Presenters from your org field.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends attendee view to hide presenter controls when presenters and attendees share the room.
claims.quote: If you're in an MTR where both presenters and attendees are present, switch to Attendee view to hide the presenter controls on the front display.

claims.claim: The low cost rating represents indirect cost only, but its rationale also includes purchasing Pro licences.
claims.quote:
cost: "low"
Low. Microsoft's notice MC1316231 says a Teams Rooms Pro licence is needed to use the feature, and no separate meter is documented; the cost is admin and communication time, plus a Pro licence for any Android room that lacks one.
claims.fix: Keep cost low only for rooms already licensed with Pro. Replace its rationale with: 'Low. For Android rooms already licensed with Teams Rooms Pro, the cost is admin and communication time; no separate meter is documented.' Keep the body warning that rooms without Pro need that licence.

claims.claim: No autonomous action is described for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android front-of-room view webinars structured meetings autonomous actions automatic presenter management. Read MC1316231, rooms-release-note and MTR event help; they describe the automatic initial view and presenter-operated controls, not autonomous actions.

claims.claim: The feature rollout is staged.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android device manufacturers updates own schedule staged rollout; Teams Android devices updates staged rollout manufacturers release schedule firmware. Read MC1316231 and rooms-release-note; they give a rollout window and device delays, not feature rollout stages.
claims.fix: Remove 'The rollout is staged and' from this bullet. Microsoft gives a rollout window but does not describe stages for this feature.

claims.claim: Device makers release updates on their own schedule.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Android devices updates staged rollout manufacturers release schedule firmware. Read rooms-release-note and android-version-support search excerpt; Microsoft documents device availability delays and OEM firmware certification, not independent OEM release schedules.
claims.fix: Replace the device-maker scheduling assertion with: 'There can be a delay between Microsoft's feature release and availability on a device make and model, so some rooms may behave differently for a while.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-release-note.
